p:
Last week began with NVIDIA, down 4.12% on Monday. By Friday an AI rout had wiped out Nasdaq's gains.

All three of our assets fell too, and at DCAcafé the DCA Score leaned in on every order.

Did leaning in change the ride?
pz:
上週從 NVIDIA 開始，週一下跌 4.12%。到了週五，AI 股的拋售抹平了納斯達克的漲幅。

我們的三個資產也都下跌，在 DCAcafé，DCA Score 每一筆下單都加碼。

加碼，有讓這段路不一樣嗎？
